Why we stopped shipping a headless browser

Our scraper spent most of its runtime waiting for a browser to boot, and almost none of it reading the page we actually wanted.

The content we called "JavaScript-only" was, in nearly every case, one documented XHR away. Replaying that request directly removed the browser from the critical path entirely.

The full migration notes are in the migration writeup, and the benchmark harness lives in the repository.

Cookie consent and newsletter prompts are not part of the article and should never appear in extracted text.
